subject: general
question: The Swaran Singh Committee recommended inclusion of which of the following features in the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental duties.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution deals with the Fundamental Duties of the citizens.
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee (1976) recommended the inclusion of 8 Fundamental Duties in our constitution.
 
• But the 42nd Amendment Act inducted 10 fundamenta
